firstPlayerRule: The player on the dealer’s left leads first and may play any card. Play then moves clockwise.
houseFallback: The page notes that ace is low when drawing for partners and deal, but does not say whether high or low deals; agree before drawing.
clarifications: The dealer’s last card is turned face up to set trumps.
